statement: If from an even number an even number be subtracted, the remainder will be even.
heath_proof: For from the even number AB let the even number BC be subtracted: I say that the remainder CA is even. For, since AB is even, it has a half part. [VII. Def. 6] For the same reason BC also has a half part; so that the remainder [CA also has a half part, and]AC is therefore even.

9.24
**Statement:** If from an even number an even number be subtracted, the remainder will be even.

Let AB be an even number, and from it let the even number BC, which is less than AB, be subtracted. I say that the remainder AC is even.

**Step 1.** Since AB is even, it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]. Let D be one of these two equal parts, so that AB is twice D. Then D measures AB, namely twice; hence D is a part of AB, the half of AB [D7.3].

**Step 2.** For the same reason, since BC is even, it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]. Let E be one of these two equal parts, so that BC is twice E. Then E measures BC twice; hence E is a part of BC, the half of BC [D7.3].

**Step 3.** Therefore D is the same part of AB, namely the half, that E is of BC. Moreover E is less than D: for BC is twice E and AB is twice D, and if E were equal to or greater than D, then twice E would be equal to or greater than twice D, that is, BC would be equal to or greater than AB, contrary to the hypothesis that BC is subtracted from AB. Hence E can be subtracted from D, leaving a remainder.

**Step 4.** Now D is that part of AB which E, subtracted from D, is of BC, subtracted from AB. Therefore the remainder of D after E is subtracted is the same part of the remainder AC that the whole D is of the whole AB [7.7]. But D is the half of AB; therefore the remainder of D after E is subtracted is the half of AC, that is, AC is twice this remainder.

**Step 5.** Therefore AC is divisible into two equal parts, each equal to the remainder of D after E is subtracted; hence AC is even [D7.6].

Therefore, if from an even number an even number be subtracted, the remainder will be even. Q.E.D.
